customer_drafts.subject: Update on your navy hoodie request
customer_drafts.body:
Hello Yale AI Club,

Thanks for reaching out about 20 navy hoodies in size M and a bulk discount. I’m sorry, but we have only 8 in size M available, so we can’t fill all 20 in that size from current stock.

We can offer a possible 20-hoodie size mix of 8 M and 12 L. We’re also confirming a proposed price of $36.67 per hoodie ($733.40 total); that price is not yet approved. Would that size mix work for your group? We’ll confirm the price and availability before making any commitment.

Best,
Campus Customs
